author: VourMa
body:
#### PR description:

HLT modules that match HLT objects to the L1T objects of the seeding filter read the
`trigger::TriggerFilterObjectWithRefs` of that filter with `getObjects(triggerType, ...)`.
They do so for Run-3 L1T types only (`l1t::JetVectorRef`, `l1t::TauVectorRef`,
`l1t::EGammaVectorRef`). Phase-2 L1T seeding filters (`HLTP2GT*ObjectFilter`) store
`l1t::P2GTCandidateRef`s, in a separate container under the same trigger types (see
`HLTP2GTUtilities.h`). These refs are ignored, so L1T matching cannot be enabled in Phase-2 HLT
paths.

This PR adds a small header-only helper, `HLTrigger/HLTcore/interface/getL1TCandidates.h`, that
returns the L1T objects of a given trigger type as `reco::Candidate` pointers, reading both the
Run-3 refs and the `l1t::P2GTCandidate` refs. It also uses the helper in:

- `HLTL1TMatchedJetsVBFFilter` (`HLTL1TMatchedPFJetsVBFFilter`, `HLTL1TMatchedCaloJetsVBFFilter`)
- `L1TJetsMatching` (`L1TPFJetsMatching`, `L1TCaloJetsMatching`)
- `PFTauL1TJetsMatching`
- `TauTagFilter`, which also gains support for `seedTypes` = `TriggerL1TauJet` (-86). This is the
  type of the Phase-2 GCT and GTT taus.
- `L1THLTTauMatching`
- `CaloTowerFromL1TSeededCreatorForTauHLT`
- `HLTEgammaL1TMatchFilterRegional`:
  - The three identical `matchedToL1Cand` overloads become one.
  - Two new parameters, `matchToL1Jets` and `matchToL1Taus`, both default `true`, which keeps the
    current behaviour. They let a filter that is seeded by a cross seed (for example two L1T jets
    plus one L1T electron) match only to the seed's e/gamma objects.
  - The `fillDescriptions` comments note that the region sizes were tuned for the Run-3 L1T
    e/gamma granularity and need updating before the filter is used with Phase-2 seeds.

Each plugin reads the same accessor as before (`p4()`, `polarP4()`, `pt()`, `eta()`, `phi()`).
Run-3 results are therefore bit-for-bit identical. No HLT menu is changed, and no Phase-2
configuration enables L1T matching yet:
- the Phase-2 VBF and tau filters keep `matchJetsByDeltaR = False` / `matchWithSeeds = False`;
- no Phase-2 configuration uses `HLTEgammaL1TMatchFilterRegional`.

The new parameters have defaults in `fillDescriptions`. Existing configurations therefore need no customisation.

#### PR validation:

- `scram b` clean, no warnings.
- `code-format` and `code-checks` (clang-tidy) clean.
- `edmPluginHelp` shows the new parameters.
- A local unit test covers:
  - Run-3 refs, P2GT refs, and both kinds mixed;
  - jets, taus and e/gammas;
  - the check that refs of other trigger types are ignored.
- No changes expected in Run-3 or Phase-2 HLT workflows.
title: Phase-2 (P2GT) L1T seed objects in HLT L1T-matching plugins
